title: BANANA GOTHAM
oneLiner: Leap Benji Banana across Gotham rooftops and grab glowing fruit before the night catches you.
mechanics: Benji Banana runs left and right across one-screen rooftops.
Press A to jump gaps, over bats, and onto higher ledges.
Collect bananas and spotlight gems to score points.
The rooftops scroll faster and hazards multiply over time.
lose: Lose a life by falling off Gotham or touching a bat; the game ends after three lives.
scoring: Collect bananas for 100 points and spotlight gems for 500 points.
